verso-plugin-vpn.description: Session grants for Verso's VPN page: OpenVPN's own config; the network and firewall configs, where an imported tunnel gets a network on its device and joins a zone; the helper's read of what the tunnels are doing and of the profiles (folded, keys left in the helper); and staging a profile through the helper's file journal. The shell holds the operator's session and performs these on the plugin's behalf (ADR-007), so this file is what makes the manifest's declared acl grantable at rpcd — the plugin itself holds no session and no privilege.
